subject: How to edit output path diagram in lavaan?

messages.author: 24c4691d56b93d0d
messages.subject: How to edit output path diagram in lavaan?
parts:
Hi everyone,

This is my first experience making path diagrams in lavaan. I want to ask how can I organize the path diagram output from semPlot/semPath? Just like we can organize the output diagram in Lisrel. If there are many observed variables, of course, they need to be organized so that they can be read properly. Many thanks!

Best regards,
Tino

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: How to edit output path diagram in lavaan?
parts:
Hi Tino,

You can try semptools, which is developed to manipulate (postprocess) the output of semPaths():

https://sfcheung.github.io/semptools/articles/semptools.html

P.S.: I can be biased as I co-developed semptools.

-- Shu Fai
